title: Surreal Dog-Woman Portrait
description: A surreal hybrid figure with the face of a young woman and the head and snout of a dog, gazing upward. Her green and purple hair flows into floral elements while vibrant pink and orange flowers bloom from her skin against a dark, dystopian cityscape background.
prompt: A surreal hybrid woman with a realistic young female face and large expressive eyes merged with a dog's snout and head, her skin and flowing hair in shades of green and purple, with pink and orange flowers growing from her face and hair, dramatic lighting, set against a dark decaying steampunk city background with gears and ruined architecture, painterly style with rich textures and vibrant color accents
